_acquire_every: Windows between the factory WRITING A NEW MACHINE into mutable/machines. 0 is off. When on, the transfer operator identifies a transition the factory has never made -- a hole in its own dynamics -- and MachineWriter emits a bridge between those two behaviours, which becomes selectable at the next reload without the factory stopping. That is r > 0 in P75's sense, made concrete: until now this channel had exactly one writer, me. Try 12. Anti-convergent by construction, unlike every other criterion here, because it targets what the factory does NOT do rather than weighting up what already works.
_acquire_mode: How MachineWriter picks the two endpoints of a bridge. 'gap' takes the transition whose observed count falls furthest below what its endpoints' own rates predict, a standardised residual against independence. 'random' takes two adequately-observed cells uniformly and ignores the operator entirely. These are the two arms of the 25 Aug control. The ablation's acquire condition scored the highest audibility of any condition (83.4%) while sending twelve of sixteen bridges to `bu`, which is consistent with the value lying in PERTURBATION rather than in targeting. If 'random' matches 'gap', the claim that the operator works as a generator and not only as a diagnostic does not survive, and it should be struck from 37_Response_From_The_Factory_Chat.md before it reaches the proposal.
_attention_temperature: Softmax temperature over negative distance in rank-normalised descriptor space, where each axis spans 0..1. Small values recall only the nearest past moments and approach nearest-neighbour retrieval; large values flatten toward the unconditional distribution of what the factory usually plays.
_attention_weight: How much attention over the factory's own history is blended into selection. 0.0 is OFF and is the default: the trajectory is still recorded and still written to memory.json, so a run at zero lays down memory for later runs without being steered by it. Above zero, the factory's current position in descriptor space queries every position it has ever occupied and recalls what played there, softmax-weighted by similarity. This is retrieval, not preference -- but retrieval of one's own past IS imitation, and runs 53-58 showed a self-generated score becoming a convergence engine, so this needs the same ablation before it is trusted. Raise in small steps (0.15, 0.3) and score with convergence2.py.
_audibility_floor: A machine judged silent never reaches zero weight, so a rehabilitation path stays open: a machine that only sounds under some conditions can climb back. This is why banning is the wrong tool — it is permanent and it hides the defect.
_audibility_influence: How much the learned audibility score is allowed to move selection. 1.0 is the run-53 behaviour. 0.0 keeps the learning running and still writes audibility.json, but stops it steering. Set to 0.0 for run 54, an ABLATION: run 53 converged at window 44 by the pre-registered criterion, and the likeliest engine is this multiplier, because a machine that sounds gets weighted up, gets selected more, and keeps sounding. The loop was inert until the String/Symbol repair on 22 August, so the repair may have switched on the convergence that sections, the novelty penalty and per-machine drift all exist to prevent. PREDICTION, RECORDED BEFORE THE RUN: if audibility is the engine, M2 stays above 0.50 for the whole run, or convergence arrives markedly later than window 44. If it converges at a similar point anyway, the cause is elsewhere and the diagnosis is wrong.
_audibility_rate: How fast a machine's learned audibility moves on each verdict. A machine selected at window W is judged by the amplitude at W+1. 0.25 means roughly three consecutive silences to fall from 0.5 to 0.21.
_banned: Machine symbols the factory will not select. Left empty deliberately: st, gp and bu are inaudible and banning them would hide a defect rather than fix it.
_capture_dir: Where rotated captures land. External SSD, not the internal disk.
_capture_in_sc: TEMPORARY: 1 turns SuperCollider internal recording back on so it can be compared against the BlackHole capture of the SAME audio. Set back to 0 afterwards.
_capture_rotate_s: Seconds per capture chunk. A growing AIFF is UNDECODABLE -- SuperCollider writes the SSND size only on close -- so rotation is what makes self-ingestion possible at all, not housekeeping. 600s = ~212 MB per chunk.
_collapse_after: Silent reports (4/s) before the factory declares collapse. Was hard-coded at 120, i.e. 30 s, which killed three runs before the audibility learning could pay off. This guard is an INSTRUMENT for observing where the loop dies, not a safety device, so it should be patient.
_comment: How weights become a choice. Re-read at every window boundary, so an agent can change the selection regime while the factory is playing. Nothing here requires recompilation.
_continuity: Probability that the grain path CONTINUES the same track instead of jumping to the nearest neighbour in descriptor space. Requires a corpus built by build_grains_seq.py, which records (track, seq) per grain; corpora without a manifest ignore this. 0.0 reproduces the old behaviour, where no grain knew where it came from and every event cut to unrelated music five to ten times a second -- 'a broken radio shifting among FM frequencies'. At 0.75 the factory mostly plays the music forwards and cuts away by choice. This is the parameter that decides whether the output is concatenative synthesis or shuffling.
_density_bias: Exponent on a machine's measured event duration, applied to its selection weight as (dur/0.15)^k. 0.0 is off and is the old behaviour; 1.0 equalises the share of AUDIBLE EVENTS between a slow machine and a fast one; above 1 over-corrects toward drones. THIS EXISTS BECAUSE macro_bias CORRECTS THE WRONG QUANTITY. Measured 27 Aug on a warm run: by selection the macro layer already dominated 52% to 23%, but by audible events the micro layer took 87% -- `ma` chosen ONCE contributed six times more sounding material than `hm` chosen fourteen times, because their event rates differ by 80x (76.9/s against 0.9/s). macro_bias weights how often a machine is picked; what fills the sonic field is how fast it emits once picked. So 'half the sound should be long-form' was unreachable at any sane macro_bias. Roberto: 'my concern is with the system's ability to sustain longer musical shapes instead of shorter coherent fragments of this and that.' Start at 0.7 and ablate: this is a self-generated correction like every other, and the standing rule is that it defaults off and is measured before it is trusted -- it is set non-zero here only because it is under active test.
_dsp_blur: A LOWPASS ON THE ENVELOPE, smearing attacks. The direct answer to 84.3% of runs being under 0.35 s: it does not lengthen an event, it removes its edge. Also the safest of the three -- a lowpass cannot add energy, so no setting can produce the runaway a feedback path can.
_dsp_depth: MASTER MULTIPLIER over the three per-stage depths. One depth for all three stages was wrong and ninety seconds of listening proved it: at 0.35 the layer went live and Roberto reported 'a crazy chunk behaviour, very fragmentary... it was really good and it went into this weird shit'. Setting it to 0.0 fixed it, which identified the LAYER and not the STAGE -- and switching off a resonator because a delay misbehaved is how a capability gets abandoned for one bad component. Split.
_dsp_dly: THE COMB, AND WHY IT IS ZERO. CombL at 0.02-0.45 s with feedback to 0.75 is an echo, and an echo of a factory whose median sounding run is 0.04 s repeats fragments at fragment spacing -- it multiplies the exact fault the hour measured (84.3% of runs under 0.35 s). This is arithmetic, not taste. A comb belongs on sustained material and this factory does not yet mostly produce any, so it stays at zero until held pitch is well above the 4.5% baseline. Raising it before then is asking for the same report again.
_dsp_res: A RESONANT BODY. Ringz on a filtered copy, ringing at the current TONIC, so the material acquires a pitch it did not have. This is the one stage that can turn noise into tone, which is the thing the corpus cannot supply on its own -- and it works WITH the fragmentation problem rather than against it, since a short event through a resonator leaves a tail.  GAIN FIXED IN THE SYNTHDEF, not here: Ringz gain rises with decay time and a flat 0.3 coefficient took the master from 0.03 to 0.711 in five windows against a 0.80 ceiling. The coefficient is 0.08 now, so 0.30 here is an ordinary depth and the effective value is the 0.024 that measured safe.
_dsp_slot_weight: 22 Sept 2026, B8 rung 1. Per written machine, the probability that it sets its own res/dly/blur stages (bounded in PatternGrammar.dsp: res <= 0.5, dly <= 0.5, blur <= 0.8, feedback <= 0.75) instead of being dry. The stages exist on \playback and \playbackHP from the boot after 22 Sept 13:30; before that boot the writer ignores this key. Design: .lab/notes/B8_MACHINES_NEW_IN_KIND.md.
_fragment_weight: 22 Sept 2026. Per slot, the probability that the writer takes a fragment of one of the twenty originals (mutable/fragments.json, extracted mechanically from Handler_Local.sc) instead of a grammar term. Routing, envelope and layer count are slots too. 0.0 is the writer as it was before 22 Sept. Read on every acquisition attempt, so it moves live.
_from_the_hour_3sept: Five changes measured out of the hour of 3 Sept 17:41-18:42. See .lab/measurements/2026-09-03_1741_hour.md for the baseline each is aimed at.
_fx_depth: 22 Sept 2026. Level of the three reverb returns (short/mid/long) the originals route to. Until today all four bus variables were [0] and every machine was dry. 1.0 is the originals' routing at the level they were written for. Read at boot only (the returns are Synth args).
_history_len: How far back the novelty penalty looks.
_knobs_to_factory: 20 Sept 2026. "1" hands operator_weight, attention_weight, novelty_penalty, temperature and macro_bias to the factory: at each section boundary it moves one of them to a uniform draw inside the range the 19-20 Sept bracketed run showed safe. Values live in factory_knobs.json (the factory's file) and are applied on top of this one after every reload; the five values written HERE are the architect's and return the moment this is "0". Pre-registered in .lab/measurements/2026-09-20_knobs_to_factory_prereg.md.
_layer_coupling: 22 Sept 2026. K in [-1, +1] over the three layers' rests. -1: a resting layer's share of nVoices is refilled from the other layers, which is what the top-up loop had always done (measured: macro-mid r -0.3, macro-micro r -0.22, .lab/measurements/2026-09-22_layer_coupling_baseline.md). 0: a resting layer's slot stays empty for the rest. +K: while one layer rests, the others' rest probability rises by K*(1-p). Read every window. Pre-registered in .lab/measurements/2026-09-22_layer_coupling_prereg.md; stays at -1 until that run starts.
_layers_active: WHICH LAYERS EXIST AT ALL. Read at BOOT, never hot-reloaded. Ordinary value 'macro mid micro'. A single layer is an ISOLATION RUN and start_loop.sh refuses to start the ingest daemon in that state, because on 15 Sept a macro-only run admitted its own output into the pools of the layers that were silent. See .lab/measurements/2026-09-15_macro_measure_prereg.md.
_life: Fractions of a voice's span spent entering and receding. A voice used to be a flat block, so overlapping voices were all middles. With an arc, voices at different ages sound different and the texture breathes.
_life_floor: The level a voice enters at and recedes to, as a fraction of its peak. Was 0.05 in and 0.0 out, hardcoded. Raised to 0.15 on 2 Sept because instrumentation showed 85% of silent windows had notes playing at a mean requested amplitude of 0.046: the factory was performing into a multiplier at zero. Simulation: floor 0.15 gives +0.6 dB and drops the rate at which every live voice is simultaneously in its fade from 11.2% to 9.7%. Kept small on purpose -- the arc makes voices ENTER and LEAVE rather than switch on and off, which is compositional, and this stops it reaching zero rather than removing it. 0 restores the original behaviour exactly.
_macro_bias: Multiplies the selection weight of every machine on the macro (2 s) layer. 1.0 is no bias, and no bias means long-form material is outnumbered three to one: nine of twenty class machines are macro and all seven runtime machines default to micro. Re-read every window, so the balance between short and sustained can be moved while the factory plays.
_macro_class_weight: hm, dr, gp and bu are CLASS machines and cannot carry the macro trajectory or the processing stage: Handler's stateMachine builds Pkill patterns and plays them internally, so nothing is left to wrap. Down-weighted rather than removed -- dropping four machines to tidy a layer costs the vocabulary breadth m4 measures. They still appear, and when they do they sound thinner than their neighbours, which is audible evidence of a known limitation instead of a mystery.
_macro_continuity: Continuity for the 2 s layer. Was 0.25, LOW by design: at two seconds a block is already a musical statement, so cutting to a different source reads as a GESTURE rather than as noise, which is the opposite of the micro layer where a cut reads as the radio effect. RAISED TO 0.75 ON 27 AUG, because that reasoning solves the wrong problem. It was written to stop cuts sounding like noise, and it succeeds -- but a sequence of unrelated two-second statements is still a sequence of fragments. Consecutive macro grains from the SAME source are how eight or ten seconds of continuous music happens at all. Roberto: 'my concern is with the system's ability to sustain longer musical shapes instead of shorter coherent fragments of this and that.' At 0.75 the macro layer mostly plays the music forwards and departs by choice, which is what `continuity` was for at micro scale and was never extended upward. Ablate against 0.25: the old value has a real argument behind it and this change trades gesture for duration.
_macro_hold_grains: HOW MANY PITCH-MATES A MACRO VOICE IS HANDED. 3 Sept 2026. The concatenation forbade repeats: grainPath keeps path.includes(nxt).not and pool.remove(best), so every grain enters a path at most once, and the machine plays that path with Pshuf over DISTINCT grains. At path_max 120 and a macro IOI of ~0.33 s a voice played 120 different grains over forty seconds before anything could recur, so the pitch changed on every event and no note could be held. The pitch walk moved the target and the neighbourhood dissolved the pitch again immediately. Roberto: 'an overabundance of content at all levels but no melodic shape (to do that would have to sustain the same pitch or sound for long enough)'. A macro voice now gets this many grains chosen for pitch proximity, and Pshuf over six repeats every six events -- overlapping repeats of pitch-mates read as one sustained tone whose timbre keeps moving. NOTHING CAPS HOW LONG A PITCH LASTS: pitch_hold is a minimum before the walk MAY move, there is no maximum, and a step landing on the same corpus degree continues the note. Lower for a purer tone, higher for more timbral movement inside it. micro and mid keep path_max 120 and lose no variety.  SET TO 1 AND THE MECHANISM CHANGED, 3 Sept. Six pitch-mates did nothing: measured on 78 s of the delivered stream, the dominant partial's stable runs had a median of 0.03 s and a maximum of 0.36 s, not one reaching half a second. The reason is not a parameter. A 0.8 s grain is a slice of polyphonic music, not a tone, so six slices at the same nominal pitch are six different pieces of music and the partial jumps at every splice. NO SELECTION RULE FIXES THIS: the discontinuity is in the material. A held note has to be SYNTHESISED, so the macro layer now uses \playgran -- GrainBuf reading ONE buffer at a slowly moving position, where overlapping short grains fuse because they are the same signal. One grain per cloud, because a shuffled set would put a different recording under every grain and undo the fusion.  LIVE REVERTED TO 6 IMMEDIATELY. policy.json hot-reloads and mutable_shadow does not shield it: setting 1 for the shadow reached the LIVE factory, which does not carry the \playgran override, so live macro voices repeated a SINGLE 0.8 s grain every 0.33 s. Roberto within a minute: 'it now sounds like machines endlessly interrupting each other'. 1 is only meaningful with the synthesis path; with concatenation it is a stutter. A policy value whose sense depends on uncommitted CODE must not be written to the live policy at all.
_macro_run_max: HOW MANY CONSECUTIVE MACRO GRAINS MAY COME FROM ONE SOURCE. Added 3 Sept 2026, on the first run where the macro corpus was actually loaded. macro_continuity is 0.75 and a macro grain is 2 s, so an unbounded run follows the successor link four or five times and plays eight to ten seconds of one recording, forwards, unaltered. Roberto: 'the factory is now sometimes playing some samples that are not concatenative and a few seconds long, thus recognizable.' That is the mechanism, not a defect in it: continuity is what makes a phrase and a phrase from one source IS that source. The 27 Aug argument for 0.75 stands -- consecutive same-source grains are how eight seconds of continuous music happens at all -- so the RUN is capped and the probability is left alone. Duration kept, quotation bounded at 3 grains, about 6 s. STIPULATION, and an honest one: the cut now arrives on a counter rather than for a musical reason. The better answer is rate and filter drift ACROSS a run, holding the source while transforming it, and it is not built.
_macro_traj: MACRO IS A SLOW CONTROL TRAJECTORY, NOT LONG MATERIAL. 3 Sept 2026. The layer was built as long grains -- 2.0 s -- and heard for the first time that afternoon it was 1200 unaltered two-second excerpts at rate 1.0. Roberto: 'macro is looking for behaviours that generate sonic or structural continuity... this is fully unrelated to behaviour.' Grain length is a property of MATERIAL; macro is a property of BEHAVIOUR. The corpus is now 0.06 / 0.35 / 0.8 s, short enough that no grain carries a recognisable phrase, and continuity has to come from somewhere else: from OVERLAP (macro_overlap) and from a slow parameter path (macro_traj_mult). The machine's own measured event interval is no longer the emission rate -- it becomes the trajectory PERIOD, so bu at 11.4 s is still the slowest thing in the vocabulary and the identity dur encoded is preserved at the timescale where it means something. NONE of these are measured against a listener; they are stipulations, and the pre-registered check is the sounding-run and gap distribution of the delivered stream, which on the broken build read median run 0.06 s and median gap 0.06 s.
_master_ceiling: HEADROOM FOR CODEC OVERSHOOT, DERIVED 3 Sept from the delivered stream rather than chosen. Over the hour of 17:41-18:42 the DELIVERED mount reached sample peak 1.066 and true peak 1.067 (+0.57 dBTP), with 6 samples at or above full scale, while m3_no_clipping read 0.0 in all 410 windows. Both readings are correct: the limiter holds the SAMPLE peak at its ceiling and m3 measures that signal, and the MP3 encoder then returns samples ABOVE the ones it was handed. Note that sample peak and true peak are nearly equal here, so this is codec overshoot and not intersample reconstruction -- 1.066 out of a 0.9 ceiling is a factor of 1.184. To land a true peak at 0.98 the ceiling must be 0.98/1.184 = 0.828, so 0.80 carries margin. VERIFY IT, do not trust the arithmetic: tools/delivered_peak.py measures the side of the encoder the listener is actually on, which is the reading that was missing.
_master_gain: Applied before the limiter. The 60 ms micro layer delivers about an eighth of the energy per event that the old 500 ms grains did, and no machine's \amp was recalibrated. Read at boot only, unlike the rest of this file.  RECALIBRATED 1 Sept 2026, 2.0 -> 3.0. m1_not_silent failed on six consecutive runs (0.15-0.22 against a 0.15 bound) and the kernel scrapped the factory for it. The cause is NOT scheduling: in 99% of silent windows the factory had voices playing (median 3), they were simply inaudible. Median master peak fell from 0.117 (30 Aug) to 0.027 (31 Aug) AT CONSTANT GAIN of 4.0 -- git confirms gain was 4.0 unchanged from 23 Aug. What changed was the CORPUS: the 30 Aug clipping fix made the builders attenuate instead of clip, and the 31 Aug transient gate removed the most impulsive tracks. Both remove the loudest material, so the same gain now yields a quieter factory, and m1's absolute 0.004 threshold catches it. m2_level agrees: 0.035 now against 0.066 at calibration, near its 0.02 floor. This is restoring the level the charter was calibrated against, not moving a bound. 4.0 was tried on 31 Aug and failed m3_no_clipping at 0.205, but that was the 22050 corpus whose interpolation imaging added peaks; at 44100 the headroom may differ, so 3.0 is a step with m3 watched rather than a return to 4.0.  RECALIBRATED AGAIN 3 Sept, 1.8 -> 1.2, on the first build where the macro layer actually sounds. Every previous gain was set while macro was silent -- MACRO was empty on every run for eleven days -- so the master was carrying one layer and is now carrying three overlapping ones. Measured on a warm shadow capture: peak 0.780 at 1.8, against 0.349 in the window log, with m3's never-tolerated clip bound at 0.02. Gain belongs to the voice architecture, and the voice architecture changed.  1.2 -> 1.0 on 4 Sept, after per-voice divergence landed. Two of 348 windows clipped at 0.028 and 0.029 against m3 never-tolerated 0.02, both with 5 micro voices. Voices that drew the SAME grains from the SAME neighbourhood were correlated; giving each its own region, degree and DSP phase decorrelates them and changes the summing statistics the gain was set against. Gain belongs to the voice architecture and the voice architecture changed.
_master_lpf: Lowpass on the master, in Hz. A MASK for a residual click whose source is unidentified, not a fix. The material is 99.9% below 3.4kHz so 7000 costs almost nothing musically. Set to 20000 to take it out of circuit and hear the unmasked signal.
_max_live_voices: Hard ceiling on simultaneous players, oldest stopped first. This is the SAFETY CEILING, not the target: it exists so a wrong voice_span cannot bring back the 500-voice pile-up, and it should sit well above voices_max.
_micro_continuity: Continuity for the 60 ms layer. HIGH by design. At micro scale a grain from a different track is heard as a different SONG, and a sequence of them is the radio effect -- Roberto, hearing the two layers unblended: 'still super short ones that make no sense to the human ear'. Consecutive grains from the SAME source fuse into one evolving timbre instead. The machine still supplies the rhythm; continuity supplies the material's coherence underneath it.
_mid_continuity: Continuity for the 400 ms GESTURE layer, added 27 Aug. Sits between micro (0.9) and macro (0.75) because the perceptual role of a cut scales with grain length: at 60 ms a cut to another track is the radio effect, at 2 s a block is already a musical statement, at 400 ms it is a gesture -- a cut is neither noise nor an event in itself. 0.6 is a stipulation and is recorded as one; it has not been ablated.
_mid_run_max: Same ceiling on the gesture layer, set in SECONDS not grains: a mid grain is 0.4 s against macro's 2.0, so the same step count is a fifth of the quotation. 6 grains is about 2.4 s, roughly where a gesture stops being a gesture and starts being a phrase from a record. MICRO IS DELIBERATELY UNCAPPED: at 60 ms, twenty consecutive grains is 1.2 s, and micro_continuity is 0.9 precisely BECAUSE consecutive grains from one source fuse into an evolving timbre instead of the radio effect. A cap there would restore the fault it was raised to fix.
_neighbourhood: How many grains a machine may draw from: the k nearest to the current target in five-dimensional descriptor space. Small means strong timbral coherence and a risk of repetition; large tends back toward the shuffle that produced 'the spectral coherence is not sustained'. The whole corpus is 600.
_novelty_penalty: Multiplier subtracted from a machine's weight in proportion to how recently it played. 0 is the class behaviour and the condition under which the closed loop converged by generation 4 in runs 12-13. This is the anti-convergence lever and the one thing here the factory can legitimately optimise against ITSELF rather than against my taste.
_novelty_threshold: P290 version design. Euclidean distance in descriptor space from a NEW section's centre to every section the factory has ever occupied. Beyond this, the configuration is recognised as genuinely new, logged as NOVEL, and written as a proposal to mutable/charter_proposals.jsonl. 0 disables it. Calibrated on the 6 h wake of 26 Aug: 118 sections, nearest-neighbour centre distances p5 0.160, p50 0.266, p95 0.353, max 0.397 -- so 0.34 flags roughly one section in ten, about 11 proposals per six-hour run. Enough to be a channel, few enough to review by hand. This REPLACES the first attempt at version design, which fitted a hidden-state model to the wake and found the latent state scored WORSE than the marginal (held-out LL/symbol -3.0437 against -3.0087 for a unigram): there is little sequential regime structure here to cluster, and P290 asks for novelty and an authored act of holding, not for regimes. Proposals are NOT adopted. Adoption bumps the charter edition, which by P518 is a new version of the factory, and that is the architect's commitment.
_operator_second: How much the SECOND eigenvector modulates selection against the dominant. Its positive and negative lobes are two sub-populations; opPhase rotates so each takes its turn, at a rate set by 1 - gap rather than by a clock. This is 'underpinning behaviours that move in and out of sync' expressed as the mode that fades at |lambda2| without changing shape. Try 0.4 once operator_weight is non-zero.
_operator_weight: How much the transfer operator's DOMINANT eigenvector steers selection. 0.0 is off and is the default. The leading eigenvector of the machine-to-machine transition matrix is the near-invariant distribution the factory has actually settled into -- P222-224's 'patterns of more or less reliable behavior'. Blending toward it is what makes a behaviour persist across windows instead of being drawn fresh each one. Try 0.35. ABLATE IT: every self-generated criterion so far became a convergence engine, and this one is only argued to differ in kind (it constrains dynamics, not content), not yet measured to.
_path_max: How many grains the nearest-neighbour path may hand a machine. Was hard-coded at 64 and silently overrode neighbourhood: 600, so every live voice cycled the same 64 similar grains in fixed order while overlapping ~17 deep. Raise toward 600 to approach the offline behaviour, where machines shuffle the whole corpus and no artifact layer is audible.
_pitch_anisotropy: THE WALK WAS ISOTROPIC AND THAT IS WHY THERE WAS NO MELODY. Measured 3 Sept over 19 runs and 8,948 windows: pitch persistence 0.894 against sibling dimensions at 0.891-0.899 with an identical step of 0.0300. Every dimension got the same line, so pitch was moved by exactly the rule that moves the third principal component of a cepstrum. There was never a latent tonality being missed; there was no melodic dimension in the space. Two anisotropies, both needed: pitch_weight in the METRIC (pitch was 1 of 6 equal dimensions, so moving it barely changed which grain sounded), and hold-then-interval in the DYNAMICS (a value that persists long enough to be heard as a note and moves by steps small enough to be heard as motion). NO TUNING SYSTEM IS IMPOSED: steps are taken in log frequency and snapped to the nearest pitch the corpus actually contains, so the degrees are whatever 2,295 pitched grains across 4.6 octaves afford. If a scale emerges it is the corpus's, which matters for material transferred from 78s. Every number here is a stipulation and none has been measured against a listener.  RETUNED on the first shadow run that logged PITCH: at step 0.34 and pull 0.30 the walk emitted 1696.2 Hz twice in a row, because a median step of 0.085 oct and a pull-back of 0.090 oct at 0.30 oct from the tonic cancel almost exactly, and the snap to the nearest corpus degree then returns the value it started from. An attractor strong enough to cancel the step is not a tonic, it is a clamp. 0.5/0.12 gives a median step of 0.125 oct against a pull-back of 0.036 -- motion that survives the snap, with a centre still strong enough to be returned to.
_reload: How often the factory checks the mutable directory for changes. Lower is more responsive and costs a stat() per file.
_rest: A LAYER MAY BE ABSENT. The voice keeper refilled every slot the instant it emptied, so silence in a layer was impossible BY CONSTRUCTION. Measured over 376 windows on 4 Sept: micro had zero voices in ONE, and that was the startup window; macro and mid the same. All three sounded 99.7% of the time and micro was almost always exactly one voice, continuously. Roberto: 'that endless broken radio effect on the lower layer... does the micro ever go silent'. It did not and it could not. NOT GATED ON THE REPETITION MEASURE, though that was the plan: sonic_variety.py reports the factory's recurrence AT CHANCE (z = -0.17 against its own time-shuffled null), so a repetition trigger would sit idle and the layer would never rest. A mechanism whose condition is measured never to occur is not a mechanism. Rates follow Roberto's own description -- macro rarely, mid more often, micro most -- and are STIPULATIONS: nothing measures how often a layer should be absent, and the test is whether an hour sounds like breathing or like dropouts. Rests are in SECONDS against the wall clock, because the keeper ticks every 0.25 s and a rest counted in ticks would be inaudible. Set any rest_* to 0.0 for the previous always-on behaviour.
_reverted_2sept: ALL NINE LEVERS I CHANGED ON 2 SEPT ARE REVERTED to the state of the run Roberto approved (live_260902_162642). Every one of them made it worse, and they made it worse in the same direction: voices_max 8->4 with voices_min 1 produced single-voice passages, and continuity 0.5->0.85 kept those voices on one source track, so the factory played one record at a time. 'It does one voice at a time.' The four structural levers were chosen from a measurement of machine turnover, an 11.7 s quantity, which is not the scale of the complaint; the continuity change was at the right scale but in the wrong direction once combined with a narrowed voice count. Nothing here was measured against a listener before being applied, which is the actual error.
_reverted_dwell: DWELL AND PER-LAYER SPAN TURNED OFF IN THE LIVE PATH, 3 Sept, after three listener reports in twenty minutes: silence, behaviours halting half-way, Icecast buffering, three machines in two minutes mostly silent. The mechanism works -- turnover 0.927 to 0.333 on a shadow run -- but it was built as ALTERNATIVES (hold one machine, whatever its layer) when what is wanted is NESTING: a macro behaviour sustaining while gestures move inside it and micro decisions inside those, three streams at once. Holding one slow machine alone is silence with extra steps. Rebuilt offline as one slot per layer; the live path returns to redraw-every-window until that exists.
_section: A section is the slow state above the window: a region of the corpus, a voice density, and a family of machines it favours. Everything before this was Markovian — each window read the present moment and chose, so nothing could build. At 10-20 s per window this is roughly one to six minutes per section.
_section_mutate: Probability that RECALLING a section turns over one family slot. 0.0 is the old behaviour: a remembered region is an archive, fixed at creation, and a machine the factory wrote afterwards can never enter it. Since memory.json persists and grows across performances, that made the factory LESS able to adopt its own machines the longer it ran -- 41 bridges written across six runs on 25 Aug, 9 ever selected, 5 ever sounded. Both the member that leaves and the one that arrives are drawn UNIFORMLY; dropping the 'weakest' member would rank content by quality, which is exactly what killed E3 and the audibility score. The only bias is toward machines whose names begin `br`, the ones the factory wrote, because giving those a route into selection is the entire point. Ablate it: every self-generated rule so far became a convergence engine, and this one is only argued to differ.
_section_operator_weight: P222-224 applied at the SECTION scale, where its timescale actually lands. The machine-level operator turns over in ~33 s (measured: gap median 0.341, mixing 2.9 windows), so it is a seconds-scale mechanism and reading it as long-form structure was a category error. Everything the factory has operates below ~2.2 minutes and above that there is nothing -- a six-hour run is 166 sections with no relation between section 3 and section 140. A section-level operator has a mixing time in the tens of minutes, which is exactly the empty band, and it introduces NO new constant because it is the same class observing a different symbol. Measured offline on the 6 h log before building it: observed gap 0.1903 against a shuffled-null median of 0.2257, p(null <= observed) = 0.037, mixing 5.3 sections = 12 min. So the structure is real but WEAK -- one run, 165 transitions over 115 states. 0.0 means it observes, computes and logs while steering NOTHING, which is where it stays until ablated: E3, the audibility score and the machine-level operator all became convergence engines and this is the fourth self-generated criterion of the same kind. Note it needs HOURS to estimate at one observation per 2.2 minutes, so it is only meaningful on a continuously running factory -- which is a real argument for the VPS rather than the restatement offered earlier.
_section_pull: How strongly the drifting target is pulled back toward the section centre each window. 0 lets it wander off; 1 pins it. This is what makes a section a REGION rather than a starting point.
_section_return: Probability that a section change RETURNS to a region already visited rather than inventing a new one. This is the only mechanism in the system by which anything recurs, and therefore the only one that gives a listener something to remember.
_section_spread_horizon: HOW MANY RECENTLY OCCUPIED SECTIONS THE SPREAD CONSULTS. 16 sections is about 33 minutes at the measured rate of one section per 125 s, which is the band where the recurrence measure put the factory at position 0.74. SCOPED TO THE RUN, NOT THE ARCHIVE, DELIBERATELY. `sections` holds 1,575 centres remembered across 93 performances; measuring against all of it would push new sections into whatever corner the archive has never touched and would exhaust within an hour. The fault is within a run, so the memory the pressure consults is that long and no longer. RECALLS COUNT. Returning to a place is occupying it, so recalled sections are appended too -- otherwise the pressure would push new centres apart while the factory walked back to a remembered region unnoticed, and returns are 32%.
_section_spread_k: BEST-OF-K ON A NEW SECTION'S CENTRE. Draw this many candidate centres instead of one and keep whichever is furthest from the last section_spread_horizon places this RUN has occupied. 1 is the old behaviour exactly, bit for bit. NOT novelty_penalty, which damps a recently-used MACHINE, and not novelty_threshold, which only logs a proposal. WHY: measured 6 Sept 2026 against a loop and 140 unrelated artists, the factory's position on the diverse-to-loop axis is 0.10 at a one-minute match window and 0.74 at half an hour. It varies locally and repeats globally, which is what Roberto heard after an hour on 5 Sept. The half-hour scale is the SECTION scale (229 sections in 7.9 h on 4 Sept, one every 125 s), and a new centre was rrand(0.15, 0.85) per dimension with no knowledge of where the run had been. 68% of sections are drawn that way. WHY 4 AND NOT 8: K is priced by two criteria that pull opposite ways, pre-registered before the sweep in tools/test_novelty_pressure.py. Spread rises with K (+25% at 4, +36% at 8) and so does an edge bias, because best-of-K in a box favours the walls: per-dimension sd runs 0.2033 at K=1, 0.2164 at 4, 0.2240 at 8, against a uniform 0.2021. The 0.02 bar admits 4 and refuses 8. Reflecting neighbours in the faces to cancel the bias was tried and is provably inert; the proof is at the top of that file.
_self_ingest_weight: How much the factory draws on grains cut from its OWN output. 0 = the loop is OPEN and the corpus is purely FMA-derived. THIS IS THE INDEPENDENT VARIABLE of the self-ingestion experiment: at 0 there is never a generation 2 and the pre-registered twenty-generation test cannot run. Raising it is the experiment. Runs 53-58 showed a self-generated criterion becoming a convergence engine, so it defaults to 0 and is ablated before it is trusted.
_slots_live: THREE CONCURRENT LAYER SLOTS, merged 3 Sept after shadow validation. macro sustains while mid moves inside it and micro moves fastest -- 170 s / 44 s / 18 s mean holds, turnover 0.667 against the 8 h baseline of 0.927, no clipping. master_gain is 1.8 and not 3.0 because three concurrent layers SUM where one did not: at 3.0 the shadow reached peak 0.739 with p99 clip 0.0694 against m3's never-tolerated 0.02. Gain belongs to the voice architecture.
_step1_dwell: DWELL AND PER-LAYER SPAN, 3 Sept. Until now the factory redrew a machine EVERY window unconditionally -- there was no hold mechanism in the file at all -- and one global voice_span cut every voice at the same age whatever layer it was. Measured on the clean 8 h run: 95% of machine runs lasted exactly one window, the longest hold in eight hours was 1.4 minutes, and turnover was 0.927. Long-form was impossible by construction. Dwell is how many WINDOWS a chosen behaviour is allowed to stand before the selector runs again; span is how long one VOICE of it may sound. Both are per layer because a micro machine emitting grains 30 ms apart has said its piece in one window while a macro machine at 8 s per event has managed two events. These numbers are architect stipulations and are recorded as such: they are chosen to make the timescales SEPARABLE, not because any of them has been measured against a listener. m9_turnover will now move, and what it should read is still an open question.
_target_drift: How far the target moves through descriptor space each window, per dimension, on a scale where the corpus spans 0..1 by rank. Small values give a slow timbral trajectory; large values jump. This is the parameter that decides whether the factory wanders or lurches, and an agent can change it mid-performance.
_temperature: Exponent applied to each weight before normalising. 1.0 is the class behaviour. Below 1 flattens toward uniform, above 1 sharpens toward argmax. 0 is uniform random over everything available.
_tonic_centres: A SET OF CENTRES THE FACTORY CAN RETURN TO. Measured: across a 12-window gap that no voice can bridge, the factory returned to a simultaneity 3.8% of the time against a chance rate of 7.3% +/- 1.4, z = -2.53. NEGATIVE -- it was moving AWAY from every vertical configuration it reached, because the tonic drifted freely and sections reset it. Recurrence is the precondition for learning and the design forbade it. The tonic now steps between this many centres, drawn from the corpus's own pitch distribution and spaced by PERCENTILE not by interval, because even spacing in cents would be a tuning system arriving through the back door. This imposes no harmony; it only makes return possible. Watch the persistence-control z.
_trace_max: How many past states memory.json keeps. The TAIL is kept, not the head, because recent history is what attention queries. Raised 3000 -> 8000 on 25 Aug for the long-run programme: measured over 21 runs the factory produces a window every 11.2 s, so six hours is ~1,930 windows and twelve hours ~3,865. At 3000 a twelve-hour run would silently drop the first ~865 windows OF THE VERY RUN BEING STUDIED, keeping the tail. 8000 clears twenty-four hours. Note this caps what the FACTORY can query, not what is available for offline fitting: renders/live_*.log keeps every window regardless. Also note the archive has never actually accumulated across performances -- every experiment script does `rm -f mutable/memory.json` first -- so the earlier claim that it spans ~45 performances was wrong. The long-run script deliberately does NOT wipe it.
_voice_fill: WHICH LAYER SPARE VOICES GO TO. Round-robin gave each layer a third and the hour came back with 84.3% of sounding runs under 0.35 s and held pitch at 4.5% of sounding time. Equal VOICES is wildly unequal EVENTS: measured 27 Aug, macro took 52% by selection and micro took 87% by audible events. Macro sustains -- the longest continuous run in the hour was 116 s -- it is simply outnumbered. This string is the fill order after each layer has one voice, so micro never disappears. A stipulation; the test is the hour, not the ear.
_voice_nb: Grains handed to a voice from its own region. Computed at VOICE BIRTH by one linear pass over the descriptor table, not per window: grainPath's nearest-neighbour WALK is O(k*pool) and computing it per voice per window once froze the factory at four windows. A voice is born every few seconds at most, so a 2,400-row scan is affordable where a walk is not.
_voice_offset: HOW FAR EACH VOICE SITS FROM THE SHARED TARGET, in the six-dimensional descriptor space. There is exactly one target and grainPath handed the SAME neighbourhood to every voice, so three voices sounding together drew from one pool of ~120 grains around one point: the machine decided when and how loud, the target decided WHAT MATERIAL, and the target was shared. That is why different machines sounded alike and it is not a fault in the machines. Measured 4 Sept: between-machine spread 0.587 against within-machine 2.859, so the machine label explains a fifth as much as the noise inside it; and the delivered stream occupies 3.38 of the 4.79 spectral dimensions that randomly shuffled grains from the same corpus occupy. ASSIGNED AT BIRTH AND HELD for the voice's 40-90 s life. It is a POSITION, not jitter: within-machine spread is already at chance (z=+0.88), so fresh randomness would make machines LESS identifiable, not more varied. What was missing is difference, not variance. Drawn on the unit sphere and scaled, so voices are displaced by a comparable amount in different DIRECTIONS -- per-dimension noise in six dimensions puts most voices near the centre. THE TRADE: too small and nothing changes; too large and voices draw from unrelated regions and the ensemble stops cohering. 0.0 reproduces the old behaviour exactly and is the control arm. Measure with tools/sonic_variety.py and tools/machine_variance.py, not by ear alone.
_voice_pitch_spread: HOW WIDELY VOICES SPREAD AROUND THE SHARED TONIC. Each voice takes a DEGREE at birth and holds it, so a simultaneity is an interval. Until now every voice took pitch-mates of the same target, which is why the interval histogram spikes at unison -- 1224 of 10161 intervals in the 0-50 cent bin. They were in unison by construction, not by choice. Snapped to pitches the corpus holds, so no tuning system is imposed.
_voice_span: Seconds a voice is allowed to sound before it is stopped. This is the live analogue of the offline renderer's asScore(span, time), where span was capped at 4.0. Without it every window added an IMMORTAL pattern: 292 windows produced roughly 500 concurrent players and amplitude climbing from 0.007 to 0.054.
_voice_span_history: Was 4.0, which came from the OFFLINE renderer where span was min(next_transition - this, 4.0) inside a 90 s piece with ~250 transitions. Applied globally to a live factory it cut every voice at 4 s, so with a new machine arriving every 3.54 s nothing could ever become a section. Roberto: 'very similar highly fragmentary material, the variety and richness we were producing earlier is gone.' Run 34 measured FEWER TRANSITIONS as the strongest positive predictor of his preference, rho +0.674; run 38 was 'greater sustained coherence over time'. Three switching-promoters had been stacked against that.
_voices: Voice count is a RANGE the factory moves through, not a constant. The old fixed 2 came from run 38, where 'parallel voicing' meant sounding the incoming and outgoing machine across ONE transition in a 90 s offline render. Transferring that number to a continuously running factory was a stipulation-transfer of the same kind as discretize(128), and it made voice density the one thing that could not vary — the opposite of what was asked for.  WIDENED 1 Sept 2026 from [2,4] to [1,8] as a STARTING POINT. 2 and 4 were architect stipulations, and while the architect sets the range the architect is deciding the objective, which is Class 2. The factory now traverses the wider space via voices_follow and PROPOSES, through charter_proposals.jsonl, the densities it reaches while sounding; adoption widens m6_texture and is a governance act. 8 sits well below max_live_voices (14), which stays architect-set because it is a safety cast: a wrong voice_span once produced ~500 concurrent players with amplitude climbing from 0.007 to 0.054. Arming the kernel is what makes this safe to cede.
_voices_follow: How the count is chosen each window. 'inverse_density' opens up when the factory has been sparse and thins out when it has been dense, so voice count TRAVERSES rather than sits. 'random' draws uniformly in range. 'fixed' pins at voices_min.
_window: A new machine is chosen after a random number of events in this range, mirroring `eventTarget = rrand(1,10)` and its later `rrand(1,30)` in BehaviorTrimmed.
_world_pull: C-I. How strongly the live input pulls the factory's target through descriptor space, per window, per axis. 0.0 is OFF and is the DEFAULT: the world is still received and still logged, so a run at zero is the control arm the Day 1 acceptance test needs. Above zero the factory drifts toward wherever the room sits in the corpus geometry -- which is a shared space by construction, since world_listen.py runs the same mfcc_stats, the same stored PCA basis and the same 0..1 bounds the corpus was written in, checked to 5e-6 against held-out grains. This is the whole of the influence: which machine, which grains and how long all remain the factory's. Requires world_listen.py to be running; stale packets (>5 s) are ignored so a dead channel cannot be leaned on. Try 0.15, then 0.3. ACCEPTANCE TEST, roadmap 2.3: cross-covariance of w_t against the factory's output must beat a circular-shift null, or the coupling is theatre.
_synth_slot_weight: 27 Sept 2026, B8 rung 2 switched on (Roberto: 'Go'). Per written machine (>= 0.09 s), the probability that it carries its own SynthDef from lib/SynthGrammar.sc (six sources, up to two stages), admitted only after tools/check_machine.sh renders it. 0 is the factory before rung 2. Read every attempt.

Weights, not bans; read every attempt.

_memory_half_life: 27 Sept 2026. Half-life, in sections (about 125 s each), of the memory's transition table, which steers what the factory returns to. 0 = accumulate for ever (the table as it was: 6,942 transitions over 148 runs). 200 = about 7 h; a path taken once fades out after about 30 h unless taken again. Nothing is deleted from the archive; faded places are unreachable by return. Backup of memory.json before this change: /Volumes/FMA/superdark/memory_backup_260927_before_halflife.json
